data.one_liner: Register and handle custom protocols and deep links in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to register custom URL schemes and handle incoming protocol URLs across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows. It provides event listeners for protocol URLs received while the app is running and supports getting initial URLs.
use_when: You need to handle custom URL schemes or deep links in a desktop or mobile Flutter app
You want to forward protocol launch URLs from secondary app instances to a running instance on Windows
avoid_when: You only need standard web URL routing without custom protocol handlers
strengths: Cross-platform support covering Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows
Queues URLs that arrive before a listener is attached
Provides initial URL retrieval and event listeners
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration in platform-specific files such as AndroidManifest.xml, Info.plist, and main.cpp
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration including intent filters on Android, CFBundleURLTypes in Info.plist for iOS and macOS, and wWinMain modifications for Windows.
